adopt: Run it, and the next decision card an agent raises pops on your desktop instead of scrolling past in a log.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Every surface an agent has on a laptop lives in a browser tab that can be closed, minimized or forgotten. The desk is the one that stays: an always-on presence that can interrupt you with a decision card, embody an agent as an avatar, and hold the Living Desktop over your real desktop. It also replaces the Windows utilities, each synced to AitherOS Online and reachable by agents through awsh, adk and AwNode under one command id: a snipping tool (PrintScreen), clipboard sync, a screen recorder (Shift+PrintScreen), a System window for processes, ports and connections, a File Explorer (Win+E, opt-in), Search this PC (Alt+Space) and a one-click public URL for a local port.

Install
see the repo -- Electron app (npm install && npx electron .)

Quick start
  npm install
  npm run demo

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awdesk/
synopsis: Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.
